"""RepoMind maintenance helper. Contract is supplied in the task."""

import re

_CANDIDATE_RE = re.compile(r"review-[0-9a-f]{64}\Z")
_REQUIRED_KEYS = frozenset(("project", "candidate_id", "revision"))


def review_identity(body, *, project):
    """Validate a review request body and return (candidate_id, revision).

    Raises ValueError for any invalid input. Does not mutate body.
    """
    if not isinstance(body, dict):
        raise ValueError("body must be a dict")
    if set(body.keys()) != _REQUIRED_KEYS:
        raise ValueError("body must contain exactly project, candidate_id, revision")

    if not isinstance(project, str) or not project.strip():
        raise ValueError("project must be a nonblank string")

    body_project = body["project"]
    if not isinstance(body_project, str) or body_project != project:
        raise ValueError("body project does not match explicit project")

    candidate_id = body["candidate_id"]
    if not isinstance(candidate_id, str) or not _CANDIDATE_RE.fullmatch(candidate_id):
        raise ValueError("candidate_id must be 'review-' plus 64 lowercase hex digits")

    revision = body["revision"]
    if isinstance(revision, bool) or not isinstance(revision, int) or revision < 1:
        raise ValueError("revision must be an int >= 1")

    return candidate_id, revision
